description: We are a team of six passionate young innovators, each excelling in different fields with unique talents and perspectives. United by creativity, curiosity and a shared passion for space exploration, we combine our strengths in programming, engineering, science, design and problem-solving to create an interactive Space Mission Design Game. Six individuals, different strengths, one mission: turning ideas into innovation.
summary:
Space Mission Frontier is a 3D space exploration and scientific simulation game developed using Roblox Studio. The game allows players to experience the challenges of space exploration by managing budgets, designing and constructing spacecraft, exploring planets, collecting soil and rock samples, deploying scientific detectors, and conducting laboratory research.

The game addresses the challenge by combining scientific education with interactive gameplay. Players must complete missions assigned by a PhD scientist, manage limited financial resources, and make strategic decisions to successfully explore the Solar System. Each mission introduces new objectives and scientific equipment, encouraging problem-solving, teamwork and critical thinking.

This project is important because it makes learning about astronomy, planetary science, spacecraft engineering and financial management more engaging and accessible. Through realistic 3D environments, planetary gravity simulation and interactive scientific experiments, Space Mission Frontier transforms complex scientific concepts into an enjoyable educational experience.
details:
1. What does your project do and how does it work?

Our project, Space Mission: Frontier, is an interactive educational game that allows players to experience the process of designing and planning their own space missions.

Players begin by selecting a mission objective and designing their spacecraft according to their needs. They can customize spacecraft components, select scientific instruments, manage their budget and allocate limited resources. Players must also consider important engineering factors such as spacecraft mass, power consumption, communication systems and orbital planning.

Once the spacecraft is completed, players can evaluate their designs and simulate their missions to see whether their decisions lead to a successful outcome.

2. What benefits does your project have?

Our project makes complex space engineering concepts more accessible, engaging and understandable, especially for students who have little experience with spacecraft design.

It helps players develop:

  • Critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Financial and resource management skills.
  • Basic knowledge of aerospace engineering.
  • Creativity and engineering design skills.
  • Decision-making skills through interactive challenges.

Instead of simply reading about space missions, players can actively experiment with their own designs and learn from their decisions.

3. What is the intended impact of the project?

Our main goal is to inspire the next generation of space explorers, scientists and engineers.

We want to make space exploration more accessible to students by transforming complicated engineering concepts into an interactive learning experience.

Ultimately, we hope our project will encourage young people to explore STEM subjects, develop curiosity about the universe and realize that designing a space mission is something they can learn to do.

4. What tools, coding languages, hardware or software did you use?

Our team developed this project using digital development tools and programming technologies to create an interactive spacecraft design and mission simulation experience.

The development process involved:

  • Programming: Lua
  • Development platform: Roblox
  • Design tools: Claude AI Pro,ChatGPT
  • Hardware: Computers for development, testing and demonstration.

These tools helped us develop the spacecraft customization system, resource management mechanics, user interface and mission simulation features.

5. How is your project creative?

The creativity of our project comes from combining spacecraft design, strategic resource management and space mission simulation into one interactive experience.

Every player can approach a mission differently by choosing different spacecraft components, instruments and strategies. There is no single design for every mission because different objectives require different engineering solutions.

This creates an experience where science, creativity and strategic thinking work together.

w6. What factors did your team consider?

Throughout development, we considered several important factors to make our game both educational and realistic:

  • Mission Objectives: What does the spacecraft need to accomplish?
  • Budget: Can players complete their mission within a limited budget?
  • Spacecraft Design: Which components are necessary for a successful mission?
  • Mass: Does the spacecraft stay within its mass limitations?
  • Power: Can the spacecraft generate and maintain sufficient energy
  • Scientific Instruments: Which instruments are suitable for collecting scientific data?
  • Educational Value: Can players understand real aerospace engineering concepts through gameplay?
  • User Experience: Is the game intuitive, interactive and enjoyable for different age groups?


Our Scientific Research Laboratory features instruments such as centrifuges, seismographs and spectrometers. These tools introduce players to sample separation, seismic activity detection and chemical composition analysis. Players can explore how scientific equipment helps researchers collect data, investigate celestial bodies and uncover discoveries, making space exploration more educational and interactive.
